rule_basis: Existing target rule candidate_last_attacking_touch=False excludes an earlier candidate when another attacker intervenes. For a normal goal, a positively recorded successful pass by a scoring-team player other than the scorer establishes such an attacking touch. Any possible assist actor must therefore be that passer or another attacking actor after the pass. This is an upper bound, not an assist award, and does not depend on source assist markers.
guards: Exclude penalties, direct free kicks and own goals. Use the latest successful type1 non-scorer scoring-team pass strictly before the goal, within60seconds and in the same period. Require one unambiguous boundary pass and unique player identity. Retain every scoring-team actor at or after the boundary timestamp, plus the passer, excluding only the scorer. Missing event identities/types, deletion or coverage markers, another goal or a foul make the rule abstain. No inferred defensive contact counts, no awarded assists and no missing-marker zeros.
validation: Freeze before outcomes. Same full2025 scoring-team plan; at least20 applicable unresolved controls and20 one-goal controls; zero infeasible team vectors, one-goal errors, protected-award conflicts or empty intersections with existing positive source candidate sets. No conflict-based selective dropping and no lower thresholds. Reused outcomes and shared Opta source mean temporal regression, not independent validation.
application: If qualified, apply to previously unresolved pre2025 goals with complete goal/scorer/team coverage. Preserve cumulative earlier candidate exclusions and every previously complete player total. Retain external quality flags, rawFPL, approved corrections and locked scoring.
